mapper.select: SELECT * FROM custom_provider ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT * FROM custom_provider WHERE enabled = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO custom_provider (name, label, icon, description, enabled, mode, config_json, source_code, metadata_tags, version, sort_order) VALUES (#{name}, #{label}, #{icon}, #{description}, #{enabled}, #{mode}, #{configJson}, #{sourceCode}, #{metadataTags}, #{version}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE custom_provider SET name = #{name}, label = #{label}, icon = #{icon}, description = #{description}, enabled = #{enabled}, mode = #{mode}, config_json = #{configJson}, source_code = #{sourceCode}, metadata_tags = #{metadataTags}, version = #{version}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
